difficulty_interpretation.difficult_but_learnable: No finish; at least one meaningful-progress cell.
difficulty_interpretation.too_easy: Both actors finished once on this geometry; not replicated ease.
difficulty_interpretation.unresolved_difficult: Neither actor reached meaningful progress; reachability unknown.
difficulty_interpretation.useful_boundary: At least one finish or high-progress cell, but not both finished.

difficulty_thresholds.progress_metric: visited tile fraction; not directed lap distance

evidence_limits: Every catalog road retained; pathological is reserved for failed frozen static/sanity checks, which abort this summary.
Only one CPU rollout per source actor and geometry; no replicated finish or significance inference.
No observed finish leaves finish reachability unknown, not impossible.
Sparse first/last nearest-road positions are sampled lower-bound location evidence only; not directed travel or a finish.
consecutive wrapper decisions with aggregated raw reward < 0; resets on nonnegative reward; retires when >100, not a geometric road boundary
one Boolean per wrapper decision; any collision among up to 4 raw frames

source_contrast.evidence_limit: One cell per actor per geometry; paired descriptions, not repeated trials or significance.
